---
title: >-
  How to Train Your Intercept: A Comparison of Intercept Update Strategies in
  Coordinate Descent
description: >
  How intercept updates affect coordinate descent for regularized generalized
  linear models, and why Newton steps help with imbalanced responses.
author:
  - Johan Larsson
  - Frederik Fabricius-Bjerre
abstract: >
  The way a coordinate descent solver updates the intercept can determine how
  quickly it fits a regularized generalized linear model, particularly when
  responses are imbalanced. We compare updates using a global curvature bound, a
  safeguarded Newton step, and exact minimization over the intercept. Our
  analysis explains how conservative updates slow convergence by failing to
  resolve the coupling between the intercept and the coefficients. Experiments
  with simulated data, real data, and production solvers show that one Newton
  step often achieves progress similar to exact minimization at a lower cost. We
  also examine quadratic approximations and multinomial models, and give
  recommendations for handling the intercept in each setting.
